senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; יָנַק)a woman giving such, wet-nurse, v. יָנַק.

units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 58a:5">Ab. Zar. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>קדח במ׳</he> tapped with a siphon.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:2">Kel. XIV, 2</cite> <he>עשה בראשו מ׳</he> if he put a knob (cup) on the top of the cane.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 5</cite> <he>מיניקות שעשאה לתחת וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:2">Kel. XIV, 2</cite> <cite ref="M01233"><he>מניקת</he></cite>) a cup which one put under a door (as a pivot).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:6">Tosef. Dem. III, 6</cite> <he>מניקית</he> ed. Zuck.; Y. ib. II, 22ᵈ bot. <cite ref="M01233"><he>מניקת</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:8:7">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵇ</cite> top <cite ref="M01227"><he>מיניקת</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 43:5">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIII</cite> <he>מ׳ ראשו</he>, v. <cite ref="M01783"><he>מָנִיכָה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>מֵינִיקִיּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="M00539"><he>מֵנִ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Zevahim 1:12">Tosef. Zeb. I, 12</cite> <he>בין במ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <cite ref="M01789"><he>מֵנִיקוֹת</he></cite>) or when he made the libation out of tubes.—V. <cite ref="M01814"><he>מְנַקִּיּוֹת</he></cite>.
